verdict.rationale: Xero exposes ledger data via a documented REST API/SDK and now ships an official MCP server plus an 'AI Toolkit' (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, prompts) explicitly for building agents on live Xero data, and markets 'instant answers about cash flow, profit trends and financial health.' However, the MCP server's documented scope (contacts, chart of accounts, invoice management) doesn't explicitly include reports/cash-flow endpoints, so there's no concrete evidence of an agent answering a specific affordability question grounded in live financial reports. Missing for 10: MCP/API coverage of financial reports or cash-flow endpoints, and a concrete example of an agent answering a natural-language affordability question using that data.
